items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Then another time I did some things with playing piano with Johnny and Lawrence, with Aaron Bell on bass and Sonny Greer on drums.

ctx.x: Because I remember Willy Smith, when he took Johnny Hodges' place in the Ellington band, and Duke had this setup where it was like a pyramid. Well, you know how he used to set up when -- I think Sonny -- no, Louis Bellson was with him. And Willy Smith would be way off to the left or off to the right, instead of sitting in with the reed section, like you normally see a band, you know?
